_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5-5 2026-10-20 06:01:43Z)**_

I added `os.remove(wav_path)` in `process_input` in [audio_processor.py](utils/audio_processor.py), right after `chunk_audio(wav_path)`. I haven't run it.

- **YouTube URL:** this deletes the full downloaded WAV and leaves only the `_chunk_N.wav` files.
- **Local file:** `wav_path` is the `_converted.wav` copy, so that copy is deleted. Your original file stays.
- **Failure:** the delete runs only after chunking succeeds. If chunking raises an error, the source WAV stays so you can retry without re-downloading.

The loose `.wav` files already in `downloads/` won't be removed by this. Delete those by hand.
